title: tillandsia stenoura var. tripinnata
intro: Tillandsia stenoura var. tripinnata, commonly known as the Air Plant, is a type of epiphyte that obtains moisture and nutrients from the air rather than through a root system. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help reduce swelling and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Tillandsia stenoura var. tripinnata include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality due to its calming effects. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
